description: Canonical merge, CI, and branch policy for the ICN monorepo. Agents must not hardcode these values — read this file.

merge.exception: Subtree merge commits (git subtree add --squash) must use --merge. State reason explicitly.
merge.agent_tooling_check_note: Runs on all PRs via .github/workflows/agent-drift-check.yml. Add to GitHub branch protection via: gh api repos/InterCooperative-Network/icn/branches/main/protection to make merge-blocking.

admin_bypass.condition: Required checks are green AND mergeStateStatus=MERGEABLE but runner is queue-stalled (pending >30min with 0s duration)

auto_merge.use_when: Required checks are still pending (not failed)

readiness_definition: All 11 required CI checks passed (includes Agent Tooling Drift Check)
Branch is up-to-date with main (strict mode)
mergeStateStatus is MERGEABLE or UNSTABLE (UNSTABLE = non-blocking checks only)

workspace.note: Run cargo from icn/ (the Cargo workspace root, contains Cargo.toml). The repo root itself has no Cargo.toml.
